quests.title: A Gift of Memories

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}! Over here! Paimon's got something awesome to show you!
Ta-da! Look at this! It took Paimon forever to dig up this treasure from that bustling market!

dialogue.sit: I say, this is... an elder statesman amongst Kameras.
Are you getting into antiques, Paimon?

dialogue.t: According to the mysterious shopkeeper, this was the Kamera used by that super famous Fontainian photographer from a few decades ago: the legendary Pierre Leblanc!
Rumor has it that the photos he took with this Kamera were all smash hits, and they'd often make it onto the front page of The Steambird!
If you use this legendary Kamera, your photos will be like... doubly legendary! And then we can sell them for Mora!

dialogue.sit: This Kamera... was expensive, wasn't it?
You didn't run into any shady merchants, did you, Paimon?

dialogue.t: It was okay! After all, Paimon's got her emergency funds to fall back on!
As long as you like it, Paimon's willing to empty her pockets!

dialogue.sit: Wow. In that case, thank you, Paimon. It's a wonderful gift.
I'll make sure to take many legendary photos with it.

dialogue.t: Yay! Paimon's happy if you're happy! Now that we've arrived in a new nation, let's put this Kamera to good use and take pictures of all the new things we see!
Paimon's also prepared a new photo album for you, just for the occasion. Paimon's reliable AND thoughtful, you see!
Okie dokie, enough chitchat! Those photos aren't going to take themselves. Let's go!

quests.description: In Nod-Krai, Paimon purchases a special gift for you at the market…
